title: 2x Yard Long Bean Plug Plants – Snake Bean, Asparagus Bean, Yard Long Huge Beans
description:
Grow something truly unique! These 2 healthy plug plants of Yard Long Bean (also known as Snake Bean, Asparagus Bean, or Chinese Long Bean) will bring a taste of Asia to your garden or greenhouse. 
Key Features: 
Impressive Pods : Long, thin, round beans up to 90cm, best picked at 30cm for tenderness and sweetness. 
Climbing Habit : Vigorous climber, reaching up to 2m tall – perfect for a frame or wigwam. 
Beautiful Flowers
